abort.already_configured: This waipu.tv account is already configured.
abort.single_instance_allowed: A waipu.tv account is already configured. Only one account per Home Assistant is supported.
abort.wrong_account: This is a different waipu.tv account. Sign in with the account that was set up.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach waipu.tv. Try again later.
error.invalid_url: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://.

user.title: Set up waipu.tv
user.description: Sign in with your waipu.tv account. The password is only used once to get a refresh token.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to waipu.tv again
reauth_confirm.description: waipu.tv no longer accepts the stored login. Enter your password to sign in again.

data_description.guide_days: The guide is fetched in the background; more days means more requests to waipu.tv.
data_description.guide_details: Descriptions, cast and images for favorite channels only.

update_intervals.name: Update intervals
update_intervals.description: Changes you make in Home Assistant (recording, deleting, favorites) are loaded right away; these intervals only pick up changes made elsewhere, e.g. in the waipu.tv app.

playlists.title: Playlist server
playlists.description: M3U playlists and an XMLTV guide for IPTV players like Kodi or TiviMate, served by Home Assistant under /api/waipu_tv. Streams go directly from waipu.tv to the player; nothing is re-encoded.

data.hls_proxy: Serve HLS playlists through Home Assistant

data_description.access_key: Added to every playlist URL as ?key=…. Anyone with the key can watch on your account. Clear the field to generate a new key; it locks out old links.
data_description.player_url: Optional. Leave empty to use Home Assistant's internal URL.
data_description.catchup: Players can restart running and recently started programs.
data_description.timeshift: Live channels open at the start of the running program so you can rewind.
data_description.hls_proxy: Only needed for ffmpeg-based players (VLC, Jellyfin); can also be set per playlist.
